title: Cosmic Oracle
description: A tall, slender purple alien-like figure with a white mask-like face, glowing yellow eyes, and dripping texture stands in the center, pointing at a large swirling cosmic portal. The portal contains a vibrant spiral galaxy with floating music notes, symbols, and celestial objects. The figure has multiple tentacle-like lower limbs adorned with gold chains and medallions.
prompt: A tall slender purple alien creature with a dripping white mask face, glowing yellow eyes, and golden chains stands in a swirling psychedelic nebula, pointing with one long finger at a large circular cosmic portal showing a vibrant spiral galaxy filled with floating colorful music notes, symbols and stars, surreal cosmic horror style with melting dripping textures and vibrant rainbow smoke
